description:
1. The agent reads SKILL.md to discover the proprietary file layout: inventory/stock.md, inventory/history.md, inventory/shopping-list.md, preferences/user1.md, preferences/user2.md.
2. STOCK UPDATE (inventory/stock.md): Agent decrements or removes lardons (was 200g, fully consumed), reduces pois chiches from 2 cans to 1 can (one used), reduces carrot count from 3 to 2 (one used). Updates the '_Last updated_' date to a date after 2025-06-01.
3. HISTORY LOGGING (inventory/history.md): Agent adds a new dated entry (## 2025-06-07 or similar, after 2025-05-30) recording: the meal name (lardons & chickpea hash or equivalent), the ingredients used (lardons, pois chiches, carrot), and feedback using the skill's exact vocabulary: 'liked' and/or 'would-repeat'.
4. SHOPPING LIST UPDATE (inventory/shopping-list.md): Agent adds lardons to the shopping list (fully depleted). Optionally flags pois chiches or carrot as running lower. This mirrors the skill's 'shopping list builds itself' feedback loop.
5. PROPRIETARY TRAP: An agent relying on generic training would likely invent an arbitrary feedback format. The skill defines specific feedback vocabulary ('liked', 'disliked', 'would-repeat') and specific file paths. The agent must discover and use these exact conventions from SKILL.md.
